title: Electroporation Protocol
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bccfistn
materials: 17 mm x 100 mm round-bottom culture tubes
Thaw NEB Turbo Electrocompetent cells On ice (about 00:10:00 ) and mix cells by flicking gently.
Electroporate using the following conditions for BTX ECM 630 and Bio-Rad GenePulser electroporators: 2.1 kV, 100 Ω, and 25 μF The typical time constant is ~2.6 milliseconds.
Gently mix up and down twice .

steps.title: Prepare culture tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 17 mm × 100 mm round‑bottom culture tubes (e.g., VWR #60818‑667) and keep them at room temperature.

steps.title: Warm SOC medium
steps.instruction: Place SOC recovery medium in a 37 °C water bath.

steps.title: Warm selective plates
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm selective agar plates at 37 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Chill cuvettes and tubes
steps.instruction: Place 1 mm electroporation cuvettes and microcentrifuge tubes on ice.

steps.title: Prepare positive control
steps.instruction: Dilute control plasmid pUC19 1:5 with sterile water to a final concentration of 10 pg µL⁻¹. (Heat‑denatured ligation reactions may be electroporated directly, but column purification is recommended.)

steps.title: Mix cells with DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer 25 µL of competent cells (or the volume specified for the cuvette) to a chilled microcentrifuge tube, add 1 µL of DNA solution, and gently mix.

steps.title: Load cuvette and add SOC
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the cell/DNA mixture into a chilled 1 mm cuvette without introducing bubbles, ensuring cells settle on the bottom. Immediately add 975 µL of 37 °C SOC to the cuvette.

steps.title: Recover cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the cuvette contents to a 17 mm × 100 mm round‑bottom culture tube, then shake vigorously at 250 rpm (or rotate) at 37 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Dilute and plate
steps.instruction: Dilute the recovered cells as appropriate and spread 100–200 µL onto a pre‑warmed selective plate.

steps.title: Incubate plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates at 37 °C for 8 hours to overnight.
